issue.body:
.eslintrc

``` yaml

---
  ecmaFeatures:
    destructuring: true

  rules:
    block-scoped-var: 2
```

test.js

``` javascript
function myFunc(foo) {
  "use strict";
  var { bar } = foo;

  bar.hello();
}

myFunc();
```

Error:

```
test.js
  5:2  error  "bar" used outside of binding context  block-scoped-var

✖ 1 problem (1 error, 0 warnings)
```

issue.title: Rest arguments are ignored
issue.body:
In the latest escope with `ecmaVersion: 6`, rest arguments are ignored. For example:

```
function f(...b) {
}
```

In this code, the `b` argument isn't found by escope.

I believe I have a fix for this. 

Related: https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/1543
